title: Animations
emptyLibrary: Save an animation to find it here, in every project.
letterMotionHint: The text stays editable. Stagger spreads letter starts across the animation; 0% moves them together. Custom outlines automatically adapt when you change the text.
name: Preset name
failed: Unable to save or load this preset. Please try again.
changed: The project changed. Open the animation picker again.
applyFailed: This animation cannot be applied to this object.
reverseHint: Swap this animation’s start and end.
select: Select an object to add motion
detailsHint: Each property has a start, an end, and optional steps in between. Time runs from 0% to 100% of this animation.
scaleHint: 100% = original size. Smaller shrinks; larger grows.

relative.width: Movement as a % of the object's width. 0% = original position.
relative.height: Movement as a % of the object's height. 0% = original position.

operation.add: Adds to the object's existing value. 0 = no change.
operation.replace: Sets this property's value during the animation.

lastPropertyHint: Keep at least one property. To remove everything, delete the animation from its footer.
endpointHint: Start stays at 0% and end at 100%. Edit their values, or remove the whole property with its − button.
